title: Cobblemon: Conquest Mod Pack
description: This is a mod pack that builds off of the Cobblemon mod pack, and increases the amount of structures and spawns legendaries at times.
body:
This is a mod pack that builds off of the Cobblemon mod pack, and increases the amount of structures and spawns legendaries at times. This mod pack is for a server for me and my friends.

    What it adds:
- Lots of structures
- Configurable ridable mounts
- All legendaries
- Configurable spawn for legendaries
- And lots more
